important_provenance: ClF7 and BrF7 were retained as explicit UNVALIDATED_CANDIDATE top rungs before this source was consulted in the current continuation.

primary_source.citation: Structural and Energetic Properties of Closed Shell XFn (X = Cl, Br, and I; n = 1-7) and XOnFm ... Leading to Stability Predictions for Yet Unknown Compounds, Inorg. Chem. 2012.
primary_source.evidence: The paper reports calculated heats of formation and F2 binding/loss energetics and states that BrF7 and ClF7 are unstable against spontaneous F2 loss by a very wide margin.

interpretation.supports: A structural coordination ladder must be separated from an energetic admission layer. Pair-loss energetics are a meaningful discriminator for high-q candidates.
interpretation.falsifies: The inference that every structurally generated v0.5 rung should correspond to a thermodynamically stable compound.
interpretation.does_not_falsify: The bookkeeping fact that v0.5 generates the rung; the rung remains in the immutable prediction ledger with a negative energetic label.
interpretation.does_not_validate: The full v0.8 Cl/Br held-out panel or any new Resonant-Chemistry Hamiltonian.

anti_fit_action: No change to d0, d*, q, the +2 ladder, or the frozen v0.8 decomposition channels is made in response to this falsifier.
